# Mental Math Daily

> A free, installable browser tool for daily mental math practice —
> multiplication tables, squares, cubes, powers and arithmetic — with
> per-topic accuracy tracking, a daily streak, and automatic spaced
> review of missed questions. No account required; all progress is
> stored locally in the user's browser.

## Main pages

- [Home / practice dashboard](https://math-daily.pages.dev/): overview, daily test, topic menu, progress and settings.
- [About](https://math-daily.pages.dev/about.html): what the app is, how data is stored, offline/PWA behavior.
- [Mental math shortcuts guide](https://math-daily.pages.dev/guide.html): worked-example shortcuts for squares, cubes, and multiplication.

## Practice pages (one per topic)

- [Multiplication tables practice](https://math-daily.pages.dev/practice/tables.html)
- [Squares practice](https://math-daily.pages.dev/practice/squares.html)
- [Cubes practice](https://math-daily.pages.dev/practice/cubes.html)
- [Powers practice](https://math-daily.pages.dev/practice/powers.html)
- [Arithmetic practice](https://math-daily.pages.dev/practice/arithmetic.html)

## Notes for automated readers

- The app itself (question generation, scoring, session state) runs client-side after JavaScript loads; each page above also includes static, human-readable text describing that page's purpose, independent of JavaScript execution.
- There is no server-side account system or API — all user data (progress, streaks, mistake history) is stored in browser localStorage only.
